CONSULAAT-GENERAAL DER NEDERLANDEN
VOOR MIDDEN-CHINA.
TEL. AD. HOLLANDIA.

No. 1706.

SHANGHAI, 8th June 1931.

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
C. & S. REGISTRY
No. S. B. D. 2371.
cie 10 - 6 - 31.

Sir,

Referring to your letter of 18 May 1931,
S.B. D. 2371, I have the honour to inform you
that according to information received from
Harbin Mr. Pavloff of the Far Eastern Commercial
Information Service is a former employee of the
Chinese Eastern Railway. It is not likely that
the Service in question will develop to something
of any importance, as already more of such like
institutions have been established in Harbin,
only to die a natural death shortly afterwards.

I have the honour to be,

Sir,

Your obedient servant,

[Signature]

Chinese Secretary.

pc SB

R. C. Alers, Esquire,
Deputy Commissioner of Police,
Crime & Special Branches,

SHANGHAI.

先生：

兹复贵处1931年5月18日来函，
编号 S.B. D. 2371，谨此奉告，
据从哈尔滨收到的消息，
远东商业情报社的 Pavloff 先生

不太可能发展成为任何重要实体，因为哈尔滨

但均在不久后自然消亡。

S.D. D-2371

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
C. & S. L. REGISTRY
No. S. B. D. 2371
Date 18 5 31

May 18 31.

Sir,

I have the honour to refer to your
letter No. 1616 dated May 13, 1931 and to state
that no information can be secured regarding
O.V. Michell and I.V. Pavloff, Director and
Manager respectively of the Far Eastern Commercial
Information Service, who are unknown to the
Municipal Police.

A note has been made of the names
of these persons with a view to having inquiries
continued, and any further information obtained
will be communicated to you without delay.

I have the honour to be,

Sir,

Your obedient servant,

Officer i/c Special Branch.

Consul-General for the Netherlands,
Shanghai.

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.

REPORT
S. 2. Station,
Date May 16, 19 31

Subject (in full) Far Eastern Commercial Information Service, Harbin.

Made by ______ and ______ Forwarded by D.S.I. Duncan.

Sir,
With reference to attached letter dated
May 13, 1931 from Mr. Van den Berg of the Netherlands Consulate
re the Far Eastern Commercial Information Service, enquiries
show that this establishment is unknown in Shanghai. G.V.
Michell, Director and I.V. Pavloff, Manager, are unknown to
the S.M.P.

Should any information be received
regarding this matter, a report will be duly submitted.

Wheeler,
D. S. I.

Officer i/c Special Branch.

（批：Mr Yao,
Letter Netherlands Consulate
saying persons are unknown in
Shanghai and we are unable to obtain
any information about them.
JY）

VOOR MIDDEN-CHINA.
TEL. AD. HOLLANDIA.

No. 1616.

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
C. & S. U. REGISTRY
No. S. B. D. 2371.
14 - 5 - 31.

SHANGHAI, 13 May 1931.

Sir,

The "Far Eastern Commercial Information Ser-
vice", Lot 91, Pochtovaia st., Harbin, of which
G. V. Michell and I. V. Pavloff are director and manager
respectively, is distributing circulars announcing
the establishment of an information bureau. In
case these persons are known in Shanghai, I should
be grateful for any information concerning them which
might be in your possession.

I have the honour to be,
Sir,
Your obedient servant,
[Signature]
Chinese Secretary.

R. C. Aiers, Esquire,
Deputy Commissioner of Police,
Crime & Special Branches,
SHANGHAI.

（左侧手写批注：）
* Sir,
No record in S.B.
Sec. of C. & S. U. Reg.
[Signature]
14/5.

（右下侧手写批注：）
S2,
For report please
[Signature]
O. i/c Sp. Br.
MAY 14 1931

上海，1931年5月13日。

先生：

“远东商业情报社”，地址为哈尔滨 Pochtovaia 街 91 号，

主任和经理，该社正在分发通告，宣布
设立一个情报局。如果
上海方面知晓这些人，我将感激不尽，
希望能获得贵方掌握的
关于他们的任何信息。

谨此致意，
先生，
